venues.name: PeoplesBank Arena

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: NOTE: The PeoplesBank Arena does not allow alternate pick up names for will call. Guests who have ordered tickets via phone/internet will need to present proper photo ID and the credit card used to charge the tickets. Both must be under the same name. Customers may pick up their tickets anytime the box office is open the day of the event. Customers must present the actual credit card used to place the order and two forms of ID, including a photo ID.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is available surrounding the PeoplesBank Arena and throughout downtown Hartford. There are 45 parking lots and garages in downtown Hartford. Prices for the garages and parking lots may vary and are run through third-party companies. For questions regarding the respective parking garages or lots, please reach out to those organizations directly.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The PeoplesBank Arena is committed to providing all patrons the opportunity to enjoy our events. For this reason, the PeoplesBank Arena and its staff make it a priority to accommodate the needs of individuals with disabilities and their companions. Mobility device, wheelchair, and limited mobility seating is available. For more info, visit the ADA Information page on our website.

generalInfo.generalRule: The PeoplesBank Arena has a no re-entry policy. Guests are not allowed to smoke in the PeoplesBank Arena. Cameras with detachable lenses, outside food and beverage, weapons, backpacks, and more are not allowed. Please visit the FAQ page on our website for the full list of prohibited items.

ada.adaCustomCopy: Accessible seating is available on online to purchase.
ada.adaHours:
Box office is open Monday - Friday 12-4 pm
    
NOTE: The Box Office will remain open evenings when an event is scheduled until 1 hour after the beginning of the event.  If a weekend event is scheduled, the Box Office will open at least 4 hours prior to the event
